# Crazy Putt Arena

Crazy Putt Arena is an original browser-based arcade mini-golf game built with TypeScript, Three.js, Rapier 3D and Vite. The target product is a full match: one human player against configurable bot opponents across themed holes, with mouse aiming, a charged power meter, arcade-tuned ball physics, a scoreboard between holes, and a rating and progression update at the end.
